label: Mailgun
blurb: Transactional email over Mailgun's API: password resets, receipts, invitations, and the threaded comms inbox. One connection per sending domain.
features: Inbound routes (replies land in a thread)

auth.key_hint: Mailgun → Settings → API Security → Mailgun API keys. Sent as HTTP Basic auth with the username api.

fields.name: domain
fields.label: Sending domain
fields.help: The verified domain mail goes out from (Mailgun → Sending → Domains).

fields.name: from_email
fields.label: From address
fields.help: Leave blank for noreply@<sending domain>. A site's own conf/sites/<slug>.ini [mail] from_email overrides it per site.

fields.name: inbound_domain
fields.label: Inbound domain
fields.help: Where reply-<token>@ addresses are routed for the comms inbox (Mailgun → Receiving). Blank = the sending domain.

endpoints.label: Send a message
endpoints.description: from, to, subject, text/html, h:Reply-To; multipart form.

endpoints.label: Domains
endpoints.description: The account's sending domains — the connect probe.

endpoints.label: Events
endpoints.description: Delivery, failure and bounce events for a domain.

endpoints.label: Inbound routes
endpoints.description: The receiving routes that forward mail to /webhook/mailgun.
